name: Hachimandaira Tsukasa
source:
Tsukasa is one of [url=/c1185]Kouhei's[/url] classmates, known as "Heji" (exclusively by Kanade). After Kouhei transferred schools, he became a good friend of his. He may seem like a delinquent, but he is very friendly. He has a twin sister.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Arterial]Wikipedia[/url].]
